$comment: Cases for web/mints.js, written before it: which token ids a collection's detail view lists. `count` cases are for collections whose ids run from 0 (series and 1/1 images): what the data file says was minted, the contract's nextTokenId and totalSupply as read just now (null when a read failed or the contract has no such function), and the number of ids to list, or null when nothing says. `edition` cases are for editions: the ids in the data file's sales list, and the supply read for ids 0, 1, 2 and so on until a zero or a failed read (null).

count.name: the data file and the chain agree
no count in the data file: the contract's next id (FLOCK, 2026-11-22)
no next id on the contract: its total supply (a 1/1 image)
the data file is a day old and the chain has more
an endpoint behind the chain answers less than the data file has
a burned token still has an id: the next id wins over the supply
the chain could not be read: the data file's count
nothing minted, from the data file alone
a count that is not a whole number is not used
a negative count is not used
a count too large to be a number of tokens is not used
a count given as text is not used

edition.name: the data file lists the ids
ids written as text in the data file
no sales list: the ids that have a supply (Eight, 2026-11-22)
three ids in a row have a supply
a later read failed: the ids before it
an id in the sales list that is not a number is left out
the sales list wins over what was read
